itens.resumo: Thai Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Sihasak Phuangketkeow noted that no single member state could tackle challenges ranging from major-power competition and economic fragmentation to climate change and energy and food security on its own. itens.titulo: Hai Phong aims to become attractive tourism destination
itens.resumo: Hai Phong will develop high-quality, smart, green and creative tourism that reflects cultural identity and generates high added value. Está a concentrar-se na implementação desta direção para desbloquear o potencial dos seus recursos marinhos e insulares, património natural e património cultural.

itens.titulo: Philippines harnesses natural ecosystems to combat rising sea levels

itens.titulo: Vietnam’s cross-border QR payments gain traction
itens.resumo: Cross-border QR payments are widening Vietnam’s tourism, retail and services links to international markets. Mas transformar ganhos de custo e tecnologia em resultados de negócios requer uma rede de aceitação mais ampla, transações ligadas à gestão de vendas e segurança operacional de ponta a ponta.
